method: Read all compact integer declarations and identity/code applicability summaries, all quantity bindings, all atomic parameter definitions, selected original predicates/fields, exact GPT05/06 decisions and finite source excerpts. Verified 99 input/source hashes. This is not a repeat of all field joins, all native guards, transitive purity, or execution qualification.

agreements.finding: 51 integer facts retain native 32/64 widths. Actual dose/ActorLife healing and long-rest HP fields are Int64; stabilization Total is Int64; ordinary check dice/modifiers, Wound LinkedInjury/clinical AddedAmount, short-rest HitDiceSpent/Healing, RP/Conviction and allowances are Int32. No generic widening or quantity reinterpretation is justified.

Blood specimen amount1 is ResourceLot.UnitId drop-black_blood_sample. Supply is mass-pound. Portable per-unit mass is independent. Fixed wound stock claim-role bindings use medical-kit, dry-ration-pounds, clean-water-pints twice, lamp-oil-pints and sundries-pounds; claim/reservation identity and current disclosure gates remain required.
GPT06 approved exactly whole portable1/1, whole vessel1/1 and trap retrieval0/1 CommandScalar request uses. Preserve zero-present trap request. No generic amount/count/dose permission follows.

ItemCount for physical.portable.currentQuantity linked/unlinked dose0/1 and UseAlchemyDose CommandScalar1/1 remain unapproved. Source proves dimensionless-looking native counts/checks, not authority to register either dimension. Input PC-N04/05/06 correctly keep decisions open. Acquire agreement for exact branch binding or change contract before implementation; do not substitute mass, CopperValue or existing unrelated CommandScalar scope.

MoraleRest RestIntervalId is empty; only SecureLongRest has real rest alias. LastCastRevision0 iff LastSpellId empty is native no-prior-cast; it is not genesis casting evidence. Input correctly retains final applicability decision OPEN. Nullable Conviction is not0; actual zero values remain available when applicable. Second==0 in stabilization/treatment is no-second-die sentinel and source-specific applicability overrides general zero preservation.

All213 existing facts remain Scalar, including repeated subject rows. Actual pending recovery alternatives are a finite identity list domain, not an input array or new arbitrary fact object. Available/unavailable value shape and homogeneous list rules match GPT06.

corrections.finding: The exact native UnitId join is valid but the current P_ITEM view does not disclose UnitId: ProjectItems emits Id, OwnerId, Available and placement/open only. The normalization preserves original claim that current lot quantity uses ResourceLot.UnitId under existing P_ITEM without separately establishing permission for the unit identity. GPT05 approves named N_ extensions, not automatic broadening of every P_ field. This mirrors the magic Purify quantity-unit gap.
corrections.required: Freeze an explicit bounded quantity-unit disclosure rule for an otherwise authorized lot/linked lot, or an independently authorized selected source-unit binding, and reconcile the single fixed key's lot-unit versus proposed dose-dimension branches. Until then retain exact native source unit internally but mark public binding OPEN; do not claim legacy view already authorizes it or silently use generic item units.

corrections.finding: The original registry still spells N_DOSE_USE base as A + P_DOSE_ITEM/current actual dose owner and custody authority. Normalization preserves that registry but its boundedAgreement names GPT06 only, so a consumer reading the preserved predicate literally can still require P_DOSE_ITEM and hide consumed unlinked-dose history. Actual GPT05 explicitly supersedes this requirement.
corrections.required: Add an explicit normalization override/reference: N_DOSE_USE = exact J_DOSE once-only receipt/use join + selected admitted profile + current retained dose owner/custody authorization + O(user), independent of P_DOSE_ITEM. N_DOSE_HEALING additionally requires O(recipient). Keep P_DOSE_ITEM for current inventory-list facts only. This implements already agreed GPT05 correction, not a new permission.

keys: all Identity facts with empty native sentinel
corrections.finding: The common emptyRule cannot alone assign NotApplicable to every missing Identity. A real parent/recipient/location failing current authorization remains Withheld, including when an existing view represents hiddenness by omission/empty. Genuine authorized absence uses exact source-specific applicability. Input's disclosure-first absentRule is correct but the shorter emptyRule needs explicit precedence.
corrections.required: State that field-specific disclosure/redaction and missing-required-projection rules precede empty-sentinel mapping. No universal null/empty=>NotApplicable rule, no hidden parent existence flag. Preserve concrete no-prior-cast, no-selected-parent and pending-recovery source sentinels only after disclosure.
